headline: Safety Scores and the Pharos Stability Index launch, followed on Mar 1 by DEWS, yield rankings, and mint/burn flows.
fieldNotes: Pharos added its scoring layer this week. Report Cards arrived on Feb 25, were renamed Safety Scores the next day, and moved from methodology v2.0 to v5.5 by Sunday as resilience factors, governance tiers, and reserve-derived dependencies were added. The Stability Index gave the whole market one composite score with annotated crisis history. On Mar 1 the DEWS, depeg tracker, yield, and mint/burn flow pages shipped, with yield and flows labeled Experimental.

summary.label: Safety Scores launch
summary.description: Report Cards debut and become Safety Scores, moving from v2.0 to v5.5 with a four-factor resilience model, governance quality tiers, reserve-derived dependencies, and peg as a multiplier

summary.label: Stability Index launch
summary.description: New /stability-index page with a 15-minute PSI cron, 24h rolling average, contributor table, and history extended with UST and IRON shadow coins and annotated crisis events

summary.label: Depeg early warning
summary.description: Multi-source confirmation for depegs on coins above $1B, DEWS stress scoring with 7 sub-signals every 15 minutes, and a new /depeg tracker page

summary.label: Yield and flows debut
summary.description: /yield leaderboard with three-tier APY resolution and lending auto-discovery, plus /flows with mint/burn event tracking for 10 coins and a Bank Run Gauge

summary.label: Reserves and coverage
summary.description: Curated reserves for 94 stablecoins on a 5-tier risk scale, 78 new contract deployments, broader DEX pool discovery, and syrupUSDC, syrupUSDT, yoUSD, GAIB AID, and apxUSD tracked

summary.label: Navigation and tools
summary.description: Collapsible sidebar, Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette, KPI bar homepage, standalone dependency map and portfolio pages, five-coin compare with share images, and CSV/PNG export

summary.label: Digest and Telegram
summary.description: Daily digest split into tweet and extended commentary, upgraded to Sonnet, redesigned as a broadsheet with a wire archive, and posted to a Telegram channel

summary.label: Platform hardening
summary.description: Circuit breakers, dual-primary prices, tighter CSP and HSTS headers, ESLint and Vitest in CI, Zod response validation, in-app data feedback, and a 34-fix post-release audit
